exports: pub const fn choose(input_len: usize, capabilities: CpuCapabilities, policy: DispatchPolicy) -> BackendId

test_vectors.name: every_selection_branch_is_const_evaluable
test_vectors.coverage: Const evaluation of scalar, NEON, AVX2 and AVX-512 selections at lengths 0, 64, 256 and 4096.

test_vectors.name: conservative_threshold_boundaries_are_inclusive
test_vectors.coverage: Lengths 0, 1, 63, 64, 65, 255, 256, 257, 4095, 4096, 4097 and usize::MAX with all capabilities.

test_vectors.name: zero_thresholds_allow_empty_input_and_preserve_priority
test_vectors.coverage: Empty input with zero thresholds selects each backend according to available capabilities.

test_vectors.name: disabling_avx512_preserves_lower_priority_backends
test_vectors.coverage: AVX-512 disabled at lengths 0, 4096 and usize::MAX falls back to AVX2, NEON or scalar.

test_vectors.name: missing_cpu_or_os_prerequisites_fall_back_without_errors
test_vectors.coverage: Missing AVX-512F, BW, OS AVX-512 state or OS AVX state; OS bits without CPU features; AVX-512 without AVX2 or NEON. The frozen function is infallible, so rejection paths are verified as fallback selections instead of errors.

test_vectors.name: thresholds_are_independent_and_need_not_be_monotonic
test_vectors.coverage: Each native backend independently uses threshold 7 while others use usize::MAX, tested at lengths 6, 7 and 8.

test_vectors.name: maximum_thresholds_are_reachable_without_overflow
test_vectors.coverage: All thresholds usize::MAX, tested at usize::MAX - 1 and usize::MAX for each fallback level.

test_vectors.name: exhaustive_capabilities_and_independent_threshold_grid
test_vectors.coverage: 128000 cases: all 64 capability combinations, both AVX-512 permission values, all 125 triples of thresholds drawn from [0, 1, 64, 256, usize::MAX], and eight input lengths. Independent raw-bit oracle selects the highest eligible backend.
